A '''shaak wrangler''' was an agricultural occupation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], dealing with the care of [[Shaak/Legends|shaaks]]. [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dren Melne]]'s [[Dren Melne's brother|brother]] worked as a shaak wrangler.<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>
